headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Home Appliances & Air Solution (H&A) revenue grew 20.9% YoY to INR 4,772 cr, driven by strong demand for washing machines, refrigerators and room air conditioners, alongside improved traction in dishwashers.
Home Entertainment (HE) revenue increased 17.2% YoY to INR 2,608 cr, supported by television demand, larger-screen premiumization and growth in B2B information displays.

EBITDA increased 28.0% YoY to INR 701 cr, with margins expanding 63 bps YoY to 9.5%, supported by operating leverage and a favorable premium product mix, despite higher commodity costs, rupee depreciation and festive-season investments.
H&A EBIT margin improved by 50 bps YoY to 8.7%, while HE margin expanded 30 bps to 12.9%.
valuation: Valuation call: We recommend BUY at the current market price of INR 1,793, with a price target of INR 2,204 (47× FY29 earnings), representing an upside of 22.9% over the next 24 months.
